name: Slovakia: 3 UEFA Cup places
description: Moves Slovakia's three UEFA Cup entries into the top group of the draw, replacing one entry each of Germany, Italy and England. Slovakia averages two UEFA Cup clubs a season wherever you manage, and always gets three when you manage there. Hungary takes over Slovakia's old small-country entry.

changes.note: Top UEFA Cup group (15 entries, 10 drawn)
Small-country UEFA Cup group (22 entries, 4 drawn)
